test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

No longer in use
solution: The correct answer is '**Obsolete**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given statement is '**Obsolete**'. • It means 'no longer useful because something better has been invented'. [प्रयोग की दृष्टि से पुरानी पड़ चुकी (क्‍योंकि उसका स्‍थान नई वस्‍तु ने ले लिया है); प्रयोगबाह्य, अब अप्रचलित, अव्‍यवहृत] • *Example: New technology has rendered my old computer **obsolete**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Obsolete.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Obscure**: not easy to see or understand. (जो आसानी से दिखाई न पड़े या समझ में न आए, धुँधला या दुर्बोध) • **Original**: first; earliest (before any changes or developments). [(किसी परिवर्तन या विकास से पूर्व) प्रथम; आदिम; मूल] • **Oriental**: coming from or belonging to the East of Far East. (पूर्व या सुदूर पूर्व के देशों का; प्राच्‍य) e5:T707, ​The correct answer is **'****To attack in an unfair manner'.**
